description: This header file declares functions, types, and interfaces related to the 'angel' component of the lighttpd server. It includes callback type definitions, setup functions, listening mechanisms, and internal 'fake' functions used for testing or internal purposes.

methods.name: li_angel_setup
methods.description: Initializes the angel interface for the provided server instance.

methods.name: li_angel_listen
methods.description: Sets up listening on a socket with a callback for incoming connections.

methods.name: li_angel_log
methods.description: Sends log messages during startup to the angel system.

methods.name: li_angel_log_open_file
methods.description: Opens a log file for angel logging, associating it with the event loop.

methods.name: li_angel_fake_listen
methods.description: Internal function for fake listening, likely for testing.

methods.name: li_angel_fake_log
methods.description: Internal function for fake logging, likely for testing.

methods.name: li_angel_fake_log_open_file
methods.description: Internal function for fake log file opening, likely for testing.
